name: code-quality
description: The proven structure-heavy winners: review, security-audit, api-review, refactor, docstring (+3 to +7 vs plain prompts on real code).

intent.goal: Review this code for bugs, edge cases, and security issues.

style_hints.claude: use XML tags with severity attributes
style_hints.gpt: prioritized markdown table with CWE where applicable
style_hints.kimi: terse bullet points grouped by severity

intent.goal: Perform a security audit of this code.

outputs.format: findings with CWE, severity (CVSS-level), and remediation

style_hints.claude: XML findings with CWE and CVSS score attributes
style_hints.gpt: markdown table: CWE | severity | description | remediation

intent.goal: Review this API endpoint design for REST conventions and security gaps.
constraints: check HTTP method, status codes, auth, error responses

outputs.format: issue list with severity, description, and fix

style_hints.claude: XML structured issues with severity attributes
style_hints.gpt: markdown issue table: issue | severity | fix

intent.goal: Refactor this code for clarity, safety, and maintainability.

outputs.format: refactored code then a brief change summary

style_hints.claude: before/after in XML blocks with change rationale
style_hints.kimi: code first, then one-line per change

intent.goal: Write a Google-style docstring for this function.

style_hints.claude: Google-style in an XML code block
style_hints.gpt: Google-style in a markdown code block
style_hints.kimi: compact Google docstring, no extra prose
